scope: Cloudflare build-chain repair: historical patch scripts may validate test source text, but they must not execute node:test suites by importing ../tests during npm prebuild.

rootCause.symptom: Cloudflare Building reports 'A resource generated asynchronously after the test ended' after v315 shows all tests passing, then aborts before Deploying.
rootCause.mechanism: Several historical patch-* scripts dynamically import node:test files while running as a normal prebuild process. node:test returns control after registration while the patch chain continues asynchronously, contaminating the test lifecycle and hiding the real downstream result.
